title: Accelerated Schrödinger-Föllmer samplers
summary: Sampling is a fundamental algorithmic task in wide-ranging applications across multiple disciplines such as scientific computing, statistics and machine learning. In this paper, an efficient stochastic Runge-Kutta scheme is proposed to accelerate the Schrödinger-Föllmer sampler, designed for sampling from complex and high-dimensional multimodal distributions.
